government_projection.source: PACKET_PLAYER_INFO plus packet-backed ruleset governments and requirements

fields.current_name: ruleset name for the exact current identifier
fields.target_name: ruleset name for the exact target identifier
fields.in_revolution: true while the packet reports an active revolution countdown
fields.selection_required: true only after revolution when a stable government must be selected

government_change.stable_state: advertise exact known, requirements-satisfied alternative governments as revolution destinations
government_change.active_revolution: advertise no government action while the countdown is in progress
government_change.selection_state: advertise exact known, requirements-satisfied stable governments after revolution

policy_boundary.proxy: projects every exact legal target without strategic preference
policy_boundary.planner: may initiate only its configured preferred government while sufficient declared-horizon runway remains; must prioritize exact post-revolution recovery

fail_closed: unknown government identifiers or identifier/name mismatches are rejected
unknown requirement kinds do not create a legal transition
the current stable government is never advertised as a transition target
no target is advertised during an active revolution countdown
normalization, sanitization, validation, exact legal membership, and packet conversion preserve government_id and government_name
invariants: a preferred-government policy cannot manufacture a target absent from the canonical legal action set
an accepted stable-state action starts only the exact packet-grounded revolution destination
post-revolution recovery prefers the exact intended target and cannot leave the player indefinitely in Anarchy
government changes remain subject to authoritative effect verification
